end.summary:
Discussed Diwali, Christmas, Pongal, Makar Sankranti, Onam, and Bihu.
Identified foods, lights, clothes, kites, and decorations linked with festivals.
Linked harvest festivals to crops becoming ready to cut, with prompts.
Recognised that regions celebrate different festivals and may celebrate the same festival differently.
Teach-back was not completed successfully.
end.parentNote: Kavya practised describing festival celebrations and connecting harvest festivals with the season when crops are ready. They gave examples such as Diwali foods, Christmas lights, and Makar Sankranti kites; the meaning of harvest festival was clarified during the lesson. At home, ask Kavya to describe one local festival using four headings: food, clothes, decorations, and flowers.
